description: Two independent 48 GB machines. No model has run on four cards here: the two pairs have only worked in parallel, each on its own job.

facts.fact: Four RTX 3090 FE cards in two NVLink pairs; each pair is passed whole to its own VM (8 vCPU, 64 GB of RAM), so the rig is two independent 48 GB machines, not one 96 GB machine.
No model has run on four cards here: no recorded launch line requests more than 2 GPUs.
Up to 4 cards generated 3D objects at the same moment, one engine per card on both pairs.
Pair A served a medical vision-language model as 2 engines, one per card, while pair B benchmarked a 27B on one card (22.0 min of overlap).
Two model-watch candidates were benchmarked at the same time, one per pair (9.4 min of overlap).

label: Two NVLink pairs, never one machine
never_measured: two tensor-parallel-2 replicas of one model
runs_counting_rule: single_model_runs counts distinct run records of one model on this configuration, whatever their status; single_model_run_copies counts the byte-identical copies of earlier runs, shown apart as '+N copies'.
